scene.location: Inside the old culvert at the first bend, looking into a small maintenance chamber north of Vespergate
scene.situation: After the alerted presence beyond the first bend went quiet, DevilMedlar asked Nyxara to cover him and moved to peek the corner himself. In the cramped passage his footing shifted while passing close to Nyxara, causing brief accidental intimate contact against her chest/hip. DevilMedlar immediately withdrew and apologized quietly; Nyxara accepted the apology and kept focus on the threat. Stealth 15 + 0 = 15 against DC 13 succeeded, allowing DevilMedlar to expose very little of himself. Perception 14 + 3 = 17 against DC 14 succeeded. Beyond the bend is a small old maintenance chamber. One hooded adult man is visible behind broken masonry with a compact crossbow trained toward the bend. His boots carry pale shrine-stone dust matching the likely carver's trail, and a stone-carving chisel is tucked at his belt. A thick leather-bound book-sized object is visible in a dark satchel across his body, strongly consistent with the stolen ledger but not yet physically verified. The man has not visibly noticed DevilMedlar's successful peek. No combat has started yet.

clues.likely_carver_route: The likely carver is now visually located in the maintenance chamber beyond the first bend.
clues.culvert_alarm: Known nonlethal warning alarm remains intact and armed behind DevilMedlar and Nyxara. It has not triggered.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still unidentified, unusually warm, and previously produced a brief stronger heat pulse when oriented deeper into the culvert.
clues.likely_carver_identification: One hooded adult man beyond the bend has pale shrine-stone dust in his boot tread and a stone-carving chisel at his belt, strongly linking him to the freshly carved Lantern Road mark.
clues.possible_ledger: A thick leather-bound book-sized object is visible in the likely carver's cross-body satchel; it is consistent with Nyxara's stolen ledger description but has not yet been seized or verified.
clues.target_readiness: The likely carver is behind broken masonry with a compact crossbow aimed toward the bend. He was alerted by the earlier noise but does not appear to have detected DevilMedlar's successful peek.
clues.nyxara_ledger_confirmation: Nyxara confirmed the woman she loves is the personally important name in the stolen Velvet Coil ledger. Identity and exact relationship remain undisclosed.
